name: conduit-full
description: RealWorld example app, built with React / Express.js / Sequelize / PostgreSQL including CRUD operations, authentication, routing, pagination, and more.

scripts.dev: concurrently --names 'Node,Vite' -c 'green,blue' 'yarn workspace backend dev' 'yarn workspace frontend dev'
scripts.start: yarn workspace frontend build && yarn workspace backend start
scripts.typecheck: yarn workspace backend typecheck && yarn workspace frontend typecheck
